notes: L01–L02 continue an earlier sentence and mention replacing D_Delta_r by D-star_Delta_r for defining Pi and tilde-Pi. The opening edit reads semble y over jouer, with a crossed and unreadable suffix still retained under doubt; the small lower addition has unresolved reading and attachment. L03–L11 call the displayed fixed-d_0 systems a hom of semi-simplicial groupoids and describe their nature as trivial, then explicitly say that this soi-disant trivialité deserves closer examination and mention the Galois theory of coverings of D-star_d0 and P-star_d0. The source’s looped mark in that parenthesis remains unresolved. L12–L19 announce an élément de structure tout à fait non-formel, use the readable wording qui ne peut s’obtenir qu’avec des hypothèses, retain a doubt over de voisinages, and then read d’intersection normale. The text attributes the 1/2 simplicial groupoid wording to the tilde-Pi family with the parenthetical NB et non les Pi. These are accounts of manuscript assertions, with no new mathematical theorem or proof supplied. The page ends mid-sentence at En d’autres. Two tiny oblique marks near x70,y1435 were inspected in the left-margin crop; they have no legible character shape or attachment and are recorded as nontextual ink flecks, not inserted as words. No watermark or prose margin note is visible. No external research, OCR or TeX compilation was used.

The lower addition’s attachment is unresolved, so it is retained near the first paragraph end instead of silently assigning it to Pour or changing it to H ici. root_adjudication: The main reader inspected the whole scan and all 15 first-reading crops. Accepted the reported source readings and retained the stated doubts. Kept lighter marginal 132 in the C margin convention, since the adjacent head numbers are 65 and 66; no claim of authorship for this marginal numeral is made. Split the long lower-paragraph blind box into three adjoining passages. Unnumbered struck-suffix doubt is retained separately from the 180 MARKS decisions.
legibility: The main prose is generally readable. The opening cancellation, isolated insertion, contracted abbreviation and looped mark after trivialité remain least secure. Several H passages have different wording from visible source phrases; C more often preserves the wording on this sheet, while its full essentiellement remains uncertain.
